music_shell_calib_blurb: Tap along to 20 clicks. Woodshed saves the offset for this input on the sound output in use.
music_shell_calib_done: Timing is calibrated for {name} on this output.
music_shell_calib_due: Timing isn't calibrated for {name} on this output. Tap along to 20 clicks so early and late are scored fairly.
music_shell_drill_mode_check: Check run: counts in your skill scores.
music_shell_drill_mode_hinted: You used a hint, so this counts as a Practice run.
music_shell_drill_mode_practice: Practice run: only Check runs change your skill scores.
music_shell_drill_tuning_flat: That {played} is {cents} cents flat, so it reads as {heard}. Your {instrument} may need tuning.
music_shell_drill_tuning_sharp: That {played} is {cents} cents sharp, so it reads as {heard}. Your {instrument} may need tuning.
music_shell_home_drills_tagline: Every drill, grouped by what it trains.
music_shell_home_paths_tagline: Step by step, from first notes to a real repertoire.
music_shell_input_clause_no_midi: no MIDI in this browser, play on screen
music_shell_input_heard_pad: Heard a pad hit. Input works.
music_shell_input_mic_failed: The microphone didn't start. Allow it in the browser, then try again.
music_shell_input_mic_flat: The microphone is on but the level below is flat. Play close to it and watch the level move.
music_shell_input_mic_off: The microphone is off. Turn it on.
music_shell_input_mic_off_screen: The microphone is off. Turn it on, or play on screen.
music_shell_input_mic_sound: The microphone hears sound (the level below moves), but it recognised no notes in the run. Play louder than the room, close to the microphone.
music_shell_input_midi_failed: MIDI didn't start. Allow it in the browser, then try again.
music_shell_input_midi_no_device: MIDI is on but no device is connected. Plug one in, or play on screen.
music_shell_input_midi_off: MIDI is off. Turn it on.
music_shell_input_midi_off_screen: MIDI is off. Turn it on, or play on screen.
music_shell_input_midi_silent_key: MIDI is on but no note arrived. Play a key to test it, or choose the input.
music_shell_input_midi_silent_pad: MIDI is on but no pad hit arrived. Hit a pad to test it, or choose the input.
music_shell_input_midi_silent_wind: MIDI is on but no note arrived. Play a note to test it, or choose the input.
music_shell_input_more_connect: More in Connect: pad maps, latency, MPC lights
music_shell_input_names_devices: Turn the microphone on once and the browser names each device.
music_shell_input_no_device: No MIDI device connected. Plug one in and it shows here.
music_shell_input_no_midi_browser: This browser has no MIDI. Play on screen, or open Woodshed in Chrome or Edge.
music_shell_input_no_midi_chromium: This browser has no MIDI. Use a Chromium browser, or the microphone.
music_shell_input_ticked: Notes come from the ticked devices, each as its instrument.
music_shell_key_picker_tip: A fifth up clockwise, a fourth up the other way.
